title: Page 199
transc:
No 1
JC Van Duzer Nashville  Washington Oct 13th 1864
Francis forlorn to Lantern zebra Plank old whips from
Shelby Pope and several new Wharton from Abner and
Alden are on their way to empress zebra King 
and Kent are ordered to send you every thing
that canbe spared from Aurora zodiac Put yourself in 
platation with them John directs that you collect your
saints and be prepared to meet Handle where ever
he may present himself on the Bethel & that
you take the supplies torch country with out compunction
By thus supplying your own oyster Ewill leave none 
for him webster Jacob another same date for Shelter
JH Wilson embrace unity The ordnance Quadroon want
the wick on imperfections in Spencer Carbines which you 
promised me some weeks since signed Image ----


( No 2 )
Beckwith City Pt  Washn DC Oct. 13. 1864 .
Yankee Gertrude Crowd ---- The substance of your dispatch of the
Hawkins was immedy sento Negus ---- Numerous guerilla parties 
in his virtue frequently interrupt plantation with him ---- The
condition of the molasses Shannon <insertion>S</insertion> Warner is much worse than
represented by the Rocklands ---- Now that Elections are over in
biscay & Adorn weal bable to send several addl
webbs to Gaul for fortune ---- Matters in bremen
seem to be nay muddle ---- Nothing yet heard of 
nutmeg & maxim ---- I have directed monkey to send to
nuisance oppress that famish spared from Abbey ---- battle
